richiami.difetto: Due to contamination during the production process the fuel filter may leak.
richiami.rimedio: Contact those supplied with the filter and provide a replacement.

richiami.difetto: The fuel filter may leak at fuel system working pressure from the top cover. This is due to a none conformance during the manufacture of the filter.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the filters that are likely to be affected and replace with quality assured units.
